purpose: Cross-session, cross-device, cross-action mistake-prevention knowledge for Luna Say Maybe character asset production. Read before every character image edit/generation and before visual approval.

coordination.rule: Always refetch latest main before action start, image edit/generation, promotion, runtime edit, and commit. Treat another device's newer evidence as authoritative and never overwrite it with stale state.
coordination.challengeRule: Do not trust another session's PASS/FAIL merely because it is recorded. Reconcile evidence, SHA/path, composite visual QA, transaction and current main. Preserve valid work; flag contradictions.
coordination.sharing: Record reusable lessons here; action-specific defects remain in transaction/PROGRESS/CHARACTER_QA_ISSUES.

mandatoryPreflight: Read WORK_SYNC.md, CHARACTER_QA_ISSUES.json, CHARACTER_ASSET_PIPELINE.md, LAYER_RULES.md, BASELINE_LOCK, current PROGRESS and target transaction.
Refetch latest main and recent commits to detect work from other devices.
If target action is already newer/formal/approved on main, do not regenerate it.
Select an APPROVED/formal parent and lock its path/SHA before editing.
Load all applicable ACTIVE global failure rules below before choosing an edit strategy.

globalFailureRules.lesson: Never solve a limb motion by redrawing the whole person or changing camera/head/body/stool registration.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Preserve face, hair, torso, clothes, scale, camera and seated anchor unless the motion strictly requires a local change.

globalFailureRules.lesson: A distant target must not be reached by merely extending a long stick from an unchanged arm.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Move/patch the required arm+hand+stick as one local kinematic unit from an approved compatible parent.

globalFailureRules.lesson: Never leave the old stick/hand geometry visible when adding a relocated stick/hand.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Explicitly inspect for exactly two sticks total and one coherent hand-to-stick connection per hand in the fixed-drum composite.

globalFailureRules.lesson: A stick that visually detaches from the hand is a hard visual FAIL even if file/SHA/static checks pass.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Composite visual QA must trace shoulder→arm→hand→grip→stick→target contact before approval.

globalFailureRules.lesson: Do not repeat the same failed image strategy after the same failure recurs.
globalFailureRules.prevent: After repeated same-class failure, hard-stop that strategy and change parent/mask/local-edit method/tool design; record retry decision.

globalFailureRules.lesson: Do not generate/advance rebound before hit is visually accepted.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Hit visual QA gates rebound and pair promotion.

globalFailureRules.lesson: Existence, SHA, workflow success and static checks do not prove a pose is visually correct.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Inspect actual character image plus locked-drum composite before formal promotion.

globalFailureRules.lesson: Rejected/NEVER_USE candidate bytes must never re-enter runtime or become a new parent.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Check transaction/QA ledger before source selection and keep rejected candidates review/history-only.

globalFailureRules.lesson: Character PNGs must not contain or move the drum kit.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Use locked drum only as separate composite QA layer; character edits remain person/stool-only.

globalFailureRules.lesson: A rebound that changes silhouette/camera/body registration too much is not a valid rebound.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Derive rebound closely from accepted hit and inspect hit→rebound→next state continuity.

globalFailureRules.lesson: A generic arm/foot semantic corridor can preserve arm contacts while discarding most BD/RF pedal-contact evidence in multi-limb repairs.
globalFailureRules.prevent: Use a dedicated RF leg/pedal ROI and keep pelvis/stool locked; never lower local-source-preservation thresholds to force PASS.

globalFailureRules.lesson: A neutral-diff corridor may produce a near-no-op candidate when the defect is a broken/detached stick whose relevant pixels fall outside the inferred corridor.
globalFailureRules.prevent: If changedVisible fails or changed pixels are negligible, switch to an explicit hand→stick→tip ROI derived from the recorded defect; do not accept the near-no-op.

promotionGate: All applicable globalFailureRules checked and none violated.
Candidate SHA/path matches the inspected bytes.
Latest main rechecked immediately before promotion.
learningRule: After every FAIL, classify whether the lesson is action-specific or reusable. If reusable, append/update a globalFailureRule in this file in the same work cycle. Never delete historical lessons; supersede with status/reason.
nextSessions: This file is mandatory read-first input for every new character image generation/edit, regardless of measure or action.
